budgets.on_exceed: record the required boundary and load only its owner

checkpoint_contract.digest_format: sha256 followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
checkpoint_contract.coverage: exactly every required output and evidence ID through the completed stage
checkpoint_contract.reuse_rule: recompute and compare the complete checkpoint identity; any mismatch denies reuse
checkpoint_contract.authority: optimization only; a checkpoint never grants authorization approval or semantic authority

outputs.discovery-findings: Read-only target findings grouped by discovery category.
outputs.resolved-composition: Selected profile modules assistants and framework pack.
outputs.installation-plan: Bounded installation or update execution plan.
outputs.approval-disposition: Required approval request or explicit non-protected classification.
outputs.staged-adapter-projection: Target-adapted files staged within authorized write scope.
outputs.output-digest-inventory: Digest inventory for every staged adapter output.
outputs.validation-evidence: Validation results bound to staged output digests.
outputs.installation-state-record: Manifest installation state recorded after validation.
outputs.installation-transition-record: Machine-readable state transition with continuous history.
outputs.assistant-handoff-message: Evidence-based post-install or post-update assistant message.

evidence.target-discovery-classification: Target findings classified against selected discovery categories.
evidence.missing-target-facts: Unknown target facts recorded without invention.
evidence.profile-selection-rationale: Selected support profile justified by target findings.
evidence.module-expansion-rationale: Optional expansion justified by evidence or request.
evidence.current-scope-authorization: Newest request classified into authorized action phases.
evidence.protected-scope-binding: Protected scope bound to current plan when required.
evidence.target-composition-binding: Target revision bound to resolved composition digest.
evidence.modify-authorization: Current-scope modification authorization remains valid for adaptation.
evidence.target-state-preservation: Target-owned and retained unselected files remain preserved.
evidence.validation-results: Structural and discovered target validation results recorded.
evidence.logical-integrity-review: Logical integrity review covers affected semantic facts.
evidence.residual-risk-record: Unavailable checks and residual risks recorded explicitly.
evidence.acceptance-recording-authorization: Current-scope modification authorization covers acceptance recording only.
evidence.acceptance-validation-binding: Installation state binds current strict validation evidence.
evidence.acceptance-approval-binding: Applicable approval evidence binds the accepted scope.
evidence.current-installation-state-binding: Handoff reads the current recorded installation state.
evidence.current-output-validation-bindings: Handoff uses current output and validation bindings.

completion_checks.discovery-category-coverage: Every selected category is classified or explicitly unresolved.
completion_checks.composition-closure: Composition dependency closure resolves without missing capabilities.
completion_checks.projection-owner-coverage: Every selected output has one projection owner.
completion_checks.bounded-plan: Planned files actions and exclusions are bounded.
completion_checks.approval-plan-binding: Protected approval evidence matches the current plan.
completion_checks.projection-composition-match: Projected outputs match the resolved composition exactly.
completion_checks.write-scope-compliance: No protected or target-owned surface changes outside scope.
completion_checks.validation-completion: Required checks ran or have residual-risk records.
completion_checks.validation-input-binding: Validation evidence still matches current target inputs.
completion_checks.transition-chain-continuity: State transition preserves a continuous previous-state chain.
completion_checks.acceptance-state-validity: Accepted state requires successful current strict validation.
completion_checks.handoff-evidence-accuracy: Message reports actual validation state and limitations.
completion_checks.checkpoint-authority-limit: Checkpoint claims no approval or semantic authority.

conditional_context: INSTALL.md when discovery or installation boundaries are ambiguous
target_context: selected project validation and ownership evidence

conditional_context: tools/scaffold_profiles.json record for the selected profile
rule owners for selected core and optional modules
prohibited_actions: enable an optional module without target need owner and validation

conditional_context: framework/change-risk-model.md when risk classification is ambiguous
framework/approval-records.md when protected scope requires approval
security owner when a safety boundary is crossed
import policy for external AI infrastructure
prohibited_actions: apply protected changes before scoped approval

adaptation.copy_policy: compare deterministic paths and hashes; do not load unchanged prose merely to copy it
prohibited_actions: copy target facts from another project

conditional_context: installer/readiness-checklist.md sections selected by enabled capabilities
focused validator for each enabled module
prohibited_actions: claim semantic correctness from structural checks
record accepted state after failed or unavailable strict validation
change adapter content outside installation-state records
reuse adaptation authorization after scope or target revision changes
